edits.old: MongoDB 5.0 changed the default global write concern from w:1 to w:majority for replica sets and sharded clusters. A replica-set deployment with at least one arbiter keeps implicit w:1 when its number of data-bearing voting members is not greater than the voting majority; in other scenarios, the default is w:majority. Set an explicit matching write concern when comparing pre-5.0 and later versions: Percona's single-member 4.4-to-7.0 insert test slowed sharply with the 7.0 default, then improved sharply after the test set global write concern back to w:1. A default-behavior change can therefore look like an engine-only regression. (high confidence)
